name: Thane
desc: In Thane, where fast-paced urban life meets complex financial planning, Hari Kotian brings 25+ years of IRDAI-certified expertise. Get personalized doorstep consultations for life, health, and motor insurance tailored to your family's exact requirements.
it_focus: High-sum-assured term plans and wellness-linked health insurance for IT executives commuting to Airoli and Hiranandani Business Park.
senior_focus: Dedicated doorstep support for senior residents of Naupada and Ghodbunder Road for policy revivals, pension advisory, and cashless medical claim help.
branch_dets: Direct coordination with LIC branch at Naupada and health insurer branches at Manpada and Ghodbunder Road.

local_faqs.question: Which hospitals in Thane are covered for cashless treatment?
local_faqs.answer: Bethany Hospital, Jupiter Hospital Thane, Currae Hospital, and Hiranandani Hospital can be accessed for cashless claims through our plans.

local_faqs.question: Can you help with claim disputes in Thane?
local_faqs.answer: Yes, we document and represent your case at the Insurance Ombudsman office serving the Thane and Navi Mumbai region, escalating from appeal to award.
